_: Sound effects made with ElevenLabs (eleven_text_to_sound_v2), two takes of each monster so they don't repeat, and a loop for each place. tools/voice/sfx.cjs fetches them by prompt and builds assets/sfx/ and js/sfx-data.js. The synthesized sounds in js/sound.js stay as the fallback.

monsters.guard: A drowned prison guard: a heavy ring of iron keys jangles, then a wet, gurgling grunt. Dark fantasy horror creature, close, dry.
monsters.prisoner: A drowned prisoner's waterlogged throat tries to moan a name, gargling and choking, iron chains clinking. Horror creature, close.
monsters.warden: A huge drowned jailer bellows from the bottom of a flooded stone hall, a deep gurgling roar, a heavy chain dragging through water. Horror.
monsters.rats: A swarm of rats squeaking and chittering, claws scrabbling on wet stone, close.
monsters.zombie: A rotting corpse groans, low, hungry and wet, close by. Horror creature.
monsters.skeleton: A skeleton's dry bones rattle and clatter as it moves, a rusty blade scraping on stone.
monsters.cultist: A hooded cultist hums a low, droning, wordless chant, eerie and slightly echoing in a stone corridor.
monsters.drowned: A drowned fisherman's corpse moans through a throat full of seawater, bubbling and gurgling, water dripping off it.
monsters.watch: A gruff armoured city guard gives a short wordless bark, chainmail rattles, a halberd butt strikes cobblestones.
monsters.hanged: A gallows rope creaks under strain, then a breathless, strangled rasping hiss. Horror.
monsters.cutter: A pickaxe strikes hard salt rock twice, crystal chips scattering, then a tired man's grunt, underground mine.
monsters.saltwight: Salt crystals crack and crunch over a dried-out body, then a dry, cracking, inhuman groan. Horror creature.
monsters.overseer: A wooden cudgel strikes rock, then a big man gives an angry wordless bark, echoing in a cave.
monsters.abbess: A ghostly woman wails a long, mournful high keen that falls in pitch, a cracked bell rings faintly, cathedral echo. Horror.

ambience.gaol: Inside a flooded stone dungeon prison: water dripping into deep pools, a distant chain shifting in water, low hollow drone. Dark ambience loop, no music.
ambience.undercroft: An ancient crypt under a cathedral: stale air moving through stone passages, distant drips, faint rat scratching, deep low hum. Dark ambience loop, no music.
ambience.town: A medieval harbor town at night in steady rain: rain on cobblestones and slate roofs, gutters running, distant sea against a stone quay. Ambience loop, no music, no voices.
ambience.hollow: A vast underground salt cave: low resonant hum of the rock, faint distant pickaxes, and very far away an eerie wordless female choir singing one note. Dark ambience loop.
